name: dependency-license-check
title: Dependency License Check
description: Prevents adding a dependency your project isn't allowed to use by reading each SPDX expression against your policy (GPL or AGPL in closed-source code, no or unrecognised license, source-available terms in a hosted product, deny lists) and catching relicenses between versions with a one-tap "Stay on" the last version under the old license, while dual licenses and dev-only copyleft pass quietly.

meta.stops: GPL dependency shipped in closed source
